H1.name: Integration misuse
H1.gap: Operator identity, separate approvals and downstream payment execution remain unverified.

H2.name: Excessive access with a legitimate operational explanation
H2.gap: Confirm effective privileges at event time and seek contemporaneous change approvals.

H3.name: Distinct event contexts
H3.gap: A shared credential or address alone cannot establish a common operator across systems.

rules.R01: A register entry and log identify the same credential inside the same system.
rules.R02: A joined bank write exceeds the announced contact-field change and lacks a recorded approval.
rules.R03: The registered LedgerOne all-module scope exceeds the modules named in the onboarding request.
rules.R04: A joined email or phone write falls within the vendor’s announced contact sync after its effective date.
rules.R05: A ticket read and a later storage read involve a key mentioned in chat. The transfer mechanism is unobserved.
rules.R06: A successful vendor PATCH and an API change share a unique request ID, vendor, field family, credential, address and UTC timestamp.
rules.R07: A user’s finance export and the integration’s export use different recorded principals and a separately documented audit context.
rules.R08: Expose missing proof or unavailable source coverage.
rules.R09: A registered HelpDeskr integration downloaded a created export from a vendor-listed high-confidence IP in its stated UTC date window.
rules.R11: A registered LedgerOne key downloaded an export from an E17 high-confidence address within its stated date range.
rules.R12: A build-labelled flow and API request share source address, destination system and UTC day. Candidate only.
rules.R13: Distinct successful August export creations reconcile to the reviewed E06 invoice count.
rules.R10: An export deletion returned an error. A final deletion receipt is needed to determine its later state.

limits: Interpretations apply to their cited event sets.
Raw record locators and original time bases are retained.
Attribution, fund movement and historical scope require additional records.
